# authwise_guard_trusted_issuer_rule (Data Source)

A rule of a Guard trusted issuer: a machine holding a token the issuer signed for `subject` may join the network with it. `subject` is the token's `sub` claim, matched exactly: there are no patterns, so no neighbouring subject joins on it. One rule per subject in an issuer. The node is named `<node_name_prefix>-<display name>`, the display name the machine sends when it joins; with `node_name_prefix` unset, the issuer's `display_name` as a DNS label is the prefix, so a name repeated across issuers says which issuer joined it. It is added to `node_group`, and counts against `max_nodes` (1 to 1000; unset is 100). `ephemeral` removes a node once it has been offline an hour, or as soon as it leaves the network. Changes apply to joins from now on; joined nodes keep what they joined with. Changing `subject` replaces the rule. Deleting a rule stops further joins; joined nodes stay. This data source reads one by its full resource name.
